user.title: Set up RoamCore WiCAN Pro
user.description: Connect to your WiCAN Pro OBD2 reader. If it's on the same Wi-Fi network, you can leave the host blank and we'll auto-discover it via mDNS.

data.host: Host or IP address (leave blank for auto-discover)
data.retention_days: How long to keep PID readings (days)

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered a WiCAN Pro
discovery_confirm.description: We found a WiCAN Pro on your network. Confirm to add it.

mqtt_confirm.title: Discovered a WiCAN Pro via MQTT
mqtt_confirm.description: We picked up telemetry from a WiCAN Pro on your MQTT broker. Confirm to add it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the WiCAN Pro. Check the host, port, and that the device is on the same network.
error.no_device: No WiCAN Pro was auto-discovered. Make sure it's plugged in and on the same Wi-Fi network, or enter its IP manually.
error.timeout: The WiCAN Pro did not respond in time.

abort.already_configured: This WiCAN Pro is already configured.
